purpose: Supplement PLAN section 19; preserve immutable baseline audit receipts

cases.scenario: Text, guided, preset and follow-up express the same scoped task
required_assertions: Exact metric/scope/period/task preserved
Unresolved constraints produce targeted clarification
Every requested goal has input provenance
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Same task across all three depths
required_assertions: Primary keys and values identical on fixed snapshot
Every added view answers an explicit useful subquestion
No quota filler or specialized metric substituted
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

required_assertions: Each number and entity binds to verified fact IDs
Facts match goal/cohort/period/clock/revision
Unsupported claims removed or deterministic fallback used
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Bottom N, Top N, ties, actual<N and pagination
required_assertions: Claim universe and direction correct
No global highest claim from a Bottom N subset
Pagination does not change ranking conclusions
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Revenue, all orders, valid orders, AOV and payment shares
required_assertions: Raw numerator and denominator match metric definitions

No averaging rates or summing distinct counts across overlaps
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Zero/negative/missing baseline, incomplete periods and forecast
required_assertions: Metric-specific change policy followed
Percentage points differ from relative change
No factual future claims or invented confidence
Incomplete coverage limits the associated claim

required_assertions: Paired data grain proven

cases.scenario: Open/close, switch selection, paginate, resize and change layout
required_assertions: Opening explanation triggers no new provider call by default

cases.scenario: Refine/filter/depth changes while explanation A is loading
required_assertions: A cannot overwrite explanation B

cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Modify outside-cohort data then modify inside-cohort data
required_assertions: Outside data preserves dependent values and explanations when membership fixed

cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Inject wrong fact, period, base, unit, direction, chart ID or causal claim
required_assertions: Each incompatible mutation rejected before publication/export
Correct numeric results do not hide irrelevant scope
Removal of required coverage caveat fails validation
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Time gaps, singleton, nonadditive shares, long labels, multiple series
required_assertions: Plot encoding preserves ordering/time distance/unit/values
Smoothing cannot invent extrema
Invalid representation falls back to valid chart/table with reason
Chart-type change cannot silently change aggregation
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Chart accordion, short answer, map, export and reopened report
required_assertions: All surfaces share selected report revision and approved goal references
Full artifact rather than preview supplies claims
Missing core answer yields partial/unavailable status rather than full success
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

cases.scenario: Advertised missions and metric families with rich/sparse/empty cases
required_assertions: Run all three depths on chosen critical fixtures
Include structured and free-text paths, multiple scopes and independent goals
Offline and live outcomes recorded separately
After changes replay failure, same family variant and regression; retain all attempts
cases.live_provider_policy: Only semantic cases needing provider use authorized Gemini context; retain existing limits

holdout_policy: Published implementation seeds, not blind holdouts. Independently author and freeze unseen variants before tuning.
acceptance: All critical scope/metric/time/claim/revision cases pass; finite corpus evidence, not universal accuracy guarantee.
